bhajan.title: Bhajorey Manasa Guru Charanam, Guru Charanam, Sadguru Charanam

discourse.excerpt: You are born for your own sake, not for the sake of any one else. You have to cure yourself of the disease of ignorance, just as you have to cure yourself of the disease of hunger. No one else can save you from both.
discourse.theme: You are born for your own sake — cure the disease of ignorance yourself; no one else can save you.
discourse.title: You Are Born for Your Own Sake

reflection: Swami says you are born for your own sake, and only you can cure the disease of ignorance — as only you can cure your own hunger. Today, take one honest look inward and drop one habit that feeds the ignorance. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4, 16 Dec 1964)
seva_nudge: Take one step of self-effort today that no one can take for you — sit for ten quiet minutes with the Name, and let it steady the mind.
